presets.name: HelloIAM Core
presets.purpose: Default identity input for every HelloIAM generator and HTML template.
presets.source: Published brand case + current production templates

identity.positioning: Meet Armenia piece by piece through food, roads, places and everyday rituals.
identity.audience: Travellers looking for small, hosted food and culture tours of Armenia.

design.logoRule: Use the AM mark exactly as supplied; do not re-letter it.
design.composition: One dominant object, strong field colour, editorial spacing and short copy.

generation.imageStyle: Tactile editorial object, clear silhouette, warm natural detail, no stock-photo gloss.
generation.negativePrompt: generic travel ad, excessive text, fake logo, glossy 3D stock render, visual clutter

presets.name: HelloIAM News
presets.purpose: Editorial preset for timely news and trend cards.

identity.positioning: Explain why an Armenia-related signal matters without turning it into clickbait.
identity.audience: People following contemporary Armenia, culture, travel and society.

design.logoRule: AM NEWS label remains visible on the cover and source slide.
design.composition: Comic-editorial frame, one source image, large headline and explicit source.

generation.imageStyle: Editorial news illustration or documentary image with restrained brand framing.
generation.negativePrompt: fake quotation, fabricated event, unreadable text, tabloid collage

presets.name: HelloIAM Tours
presets.purpose: Website and sales material for hosted Armenia tours.

identity.positioning: Small-group food and culture tours with every practical detail handled.
identity.audience: International travellers considering a first or deeper visit to Armenia.

design.logoRule: Use HELLOIAM.AM wordmark with approved spacing.
design.composition: Destination image plus one practical promise and one clear CTA.

generation.imageStyle: Natural Armenia travel photography, human scale, food and place details, warm available light.
generation.negativePrompt: generic resort, crowds, staged hospitality, oversaturated landscape
